m: Cook the brown rice (25 to 30 minutes).
Poach the chicken: cover with cold salted water, bring to a gentle simmer, then turn off the heat and leave covered for 15 minutes. Cool a little and shred.
Dressing: fish sauce, lime juice, sugar, finely chopped garlic and chilli, plus 1 tbsp water per serve.
Shred the cabbage as thin as you can. Cut the carrot and cucumber into matchsticks.
Toss the veg, chicken and torn herbs with the dressing.
Serve over rice, topped with crushed peanuts.
l: Pack the dressing separately and toss just before eating so the salad stays crunchy.
g: Naturally gluten free. Check the fish sauce.
